arguments.summary: The 502s on the checkout page were caused by an ingress idle timeout of 30 seconds, not a downed database. The certificate had expired and was not renewed automatically. Cron does not run jobs in random order. The failed-jobs backlog was blocked by 47 malformed rows, which were deleted to unblock the queue and restart pgbouncer.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Monitor the database for full disk space issues, and ensure certificates are renewed on time. Schedule a review of the cron job behavior to understand any discrepancies.
